algorithm: Decoder-only diffusion transformer (28 layers, hidden size 1024, 16 attention heads) with T5 (language) and SigLIP (vision) encoders feeding conditional tokens; DDPM training, DPMSolver++ sampling for inference; training clips reweighted by a discriminator trained with a positive-unlabeled objective (DWBC-style score-to-weight mapping) that scores demonstration quality
hand: XHAND dexterous hand (paired), 12 fully actuated joints per hand, thumb and index additionally support lateral ab/adduction
sim: MuJoCo (digital twin of the real platform, used to generate the synthetic corpus and mirrored in real-time teleoperation)
success_criterion: Task-specific human/experimenter-judged success; no metric threshold in metres/radians/seconds defined; reported as success rate over 20 rollouts/trials per task
headline_metric: Success rate (%) averaged over dexterous task suite
headline_value: 66.7% avg success (Table II, dexterous tasks) vs 51.7% GR00T N1, 26.7% pi0, 6.7% Diffusion Policy baselines; 89.6% avg on basic tasks (Table I) vs 82.1% GR00T N1
human_data: Real teleoperated demonstrations collected via hybrid teleoperation (arm exoskeleton + Apple Vision Pro finger tracking); 347 objects/17 categories, 200 tasks, 50 demos/task, 10K episodes total
note_gaps: Real-dataset duration internally inconsistent (177.5h in Sec I vs 40.5h in Sec III-B for ~3M frames); ambiguous whether the dexterous benchmark (Table II) trained Dexora zero-shot or fine-tuned, unlike the explicit 'zero-shot' statement for the basic-task suite; loss equations (RMS acceleration/jerk, positive-unlabeled loss, weighted diffusion loss) were dropped by PDF-to-markdown conversion so cannot be quoted verbatim; GPU/wall-clock training time not stated; code/data release claimed in Abstract only, unverified (no code/md file exists for this key).
backbone: No single monolithic VLM; separate pretrained T5 (language) and SigLIP (vision) encoders feeding a custom decoder-only diffusion transformer (28 layers, hidden size 1024, 16 attention heads)
params: Policy parameter count not stated (only the discriminator's is given: 30M, 12 layers, hidden size 512, 8 attention heads)
action_head: Decoder-only diffusion transformer predicting full 36-DoF dual-arm dual-hand joint-angle action chunks (L=32) via DDPM training and DPMSolver++ sampling for acceleration
pretrain_data: Synthetic MuJoCo corpus: 297 objects/30 categories, 200 tasks, ~500 traj/task via DexMimicGen expansion, ~6.5M frames/361h video; plus real teleoperated set: 347 objects/17 categories, 200 tasks, 50 demos/task, 10K episodes
dexterous_evidence: As shown in Fig. 3 (a), Dexora integrates two 6-DoF AIRBOT arms with a pair of XHAND dexterous hands, each offering 12 fully actuated joints. (Sec III-A)
